information.en:
This is an example study, made to try Combray. The researchers of the Combray project run it.

We ask for your YouTube watch history and Google searches, to see how people remember what they watched and looked for. Only what you choose to share is sent, encrypted so that only the researchers can open it.

Taking part is voluntary. You can withdraw your donation on this page at any time. Questions? Ask the researcher who gave you the link.
information.nl:
Dit is een voorbeeldonderzoek, gemaakt om Combray uit te proberen. De onderzoekers van het Combray-project voeren het uit.

We vragen om je YouTube-kijkgeschiedenis en Google-zoekopdrachten, om te zien hoe mensen zich herinneren wat ze bekeken en zochten. Alleen wat je kiest te delen wordt verstuurd, versleuteld zodat alleen de onderzoekers het kunnen openen.

Meedoen is vrijwillig. Je kunt je donatie op elk moment op deze pagina intrekken. Vragen? Stel ze aan de onderzoeker die je de link gaf.

statements.en: I have read the information about this study.
statements.nl: Ik heb de informatie over dit onderzoek gelezen.

text.en:
Let's take a short walk through what you watched. Everything you see here is worked out on your own computer.

Along the way we ask a few questions. You can skip any of them.
text.nl:
We maken een korte wandeling door wat je hebt bekeken. Alles wat je hier ziet wordt op je eigen computer uitgerekend.

Onderweg stellen we een paar vragen. Die mag je allemaal overslaan.

text.en: You watched {count} videos: about {per_day} a day.
text.nl: Je keek {count} video's: ongeveer {per_day} per dag.

prompt.en: Is that more or less than you expected?
prompt.nl: Is dat meer of minder dan je had verwacht?

prompt.en: Why do you think this one is at the top?
prompt.nl: Waarom denk je dat deze bovenaan staat?

prompt.en: What was going on in your life around then?
prompt.nl: Wat speelde er in die tijd in je leven?

prompt.en: How many hours a day do you think you spend on YouTube?
prompt.nl: Hoeveel uur per dag denk je dat je op YouTube zit?

text.nl: En je zocht {count} keer op Google.

empty.en: You did not add any Google searches. That's fine!
empty.nl: Je hebt geen Google-zoekopdrachten toegevoegd. Dat is prima!

note: An example project for development: import it with `pnpm admin project import deploy/examples/projects/*.json`, which creates the project and publishes it. Researchers edit projects in the studio. participants.mode is anonymous, optional or required; participants.pattern (a regular expression the whole id must match, such as W-[0-9]{4}; no quantified groups, at most two * or +, 100 characters) is optional and never sent to participants. uploads lists the platforms; each starts from a bundled platform pack (pack), or carries the project's own tree (structure and importer, as the studio saves them). consent (optional) holds the information participants read before donating (plain text, an empty line between paragraphs) and up to 10 statements they must all tick. story (optional) is what participants are walked through: slides of text, data views (amount, top, over-time, rhythm) on a table and column by their ids, and questions (open, choice, number); the studio's Story tab edits it.
